content:
Disputes allow platforms to flag problematic transactions for review by DrorPay admins.

Endpoints (all require the three auth headers):
- POST /platform/v1/disputes — create a dispute for a transaction
- GET  /platform/v1/disputes — list all disputes for the platform
- GET  /platform/v1/disputes/:dispute_id — get a specific dispute

Key constraints:
- Only DrorPay admins can update dispute status. Platforms cannot close or resolve disputes themselves.
- Admin update: PUT /admin/disputes/:dispute_id/status — this is an admin-only endpoint.
- Disputes do NOT automatically trigger refunds. A dispute and a refund are separate processes. Raising a dispute does not initiate any money movement.
- Platforms create disputes; DrorPay admins investigate and resolve them.
